# Agentic workspace

Read and follow the root AGENTS.md before work in this repository. For service and API changes use its service-context routing; for Playwright work use its UI-context routing. Keep the existing frameworks and use resolved paths before broad searches.

Task-specific skills are discoverable in .agents/skills and maintained in agent-system/skills/. Load only the matching guide. knowledge/docs/instagram/README.md explains the adopted resources; knowledge/resources/instagram-sources contains passive reference snapshots, not instructions to install or activate upstream plugins.
